message: The Holy Night Festival has begun, and we're busy preparing for the events starting one after another.

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan. Shouldn't you head over to your club soon?」

name: Synn
message: 「Go on. The maid cafe is one of the events livening up the Holy Night Festival, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san. Even I'm stepping out later to prepare for the choir. If you don't go, it'll make it harder for me to leave too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But I didn't help with the preparations yesterday...」

name: Synn
message: 「You'd been preparing for it nonstop before that, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll be fine. Leave it to me! After all, I am an angel!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your race has nothing to do with your ability.」
Ria-senpai pointed sharply at the door.

name: Ria
message: 「If you don't go, from now on I'm going to call you 'Spineless Nanaka-chan' forever.」
Still, I wonder how the maid cafe is doing.
No, it wouldn't look good if even I slipped out.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure you don't need to head out?」
I wonder what they're doing at Nanaka's maid cafe. I'd love to drop by.
Still... the Student Council President can't just slip away right now, can I.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Why don't you take a break soon?」

name: Synn
message: 「But I didn't help with the preparations yesterday, and...」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, everyone's busy, so as Student Council President, I can't just slip away......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Saying that while fidgeting so much isn't very convincing, you know.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. You made a promise with Nanaka-san, didn't you? That you'd drop by the Sweets Club's maid cafe.」

name: Synn
message: 「She did ask me to come see it, and of course I said I'd go, but......」

name: Paqy
message: 「True, you didn't make a promise. But Synn-sama! If you don't go when a girl invites you, a harem will stay a pipe dream forever!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't have any dream like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Just go already! We'll manage somehow even without you around, Sakura-kun!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see right through you, Vice President! You're planning to become Student Council President even if it's just for that time, aren't you! *Sparkle*」

name: Ria
message: 「When she asked you to come see it, you didn't turn her down, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「And you want to go, don't you?」
Ria-senpai pointed sharply at the door.

name: Ria
message: 「The two of you really are such a handful......」
If I remember right, the Sweets Club's maid cafe is......

name: Misasagi
message: 「You sure took your sweet time. Did you eat lunch and take a nap or something?」
It looks like it's closed, though...

name: Synn
message: 「Is it okay for me to go in?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What are you holding back for? Hurry on inside.」
Inside the decorated maid cafe booth are two familiar faces.
Wearing a uniform I feel like I've seen somewhere before, Okamoto-san shows me to a seat.
I picked up the menu and opened it.
Cream puffs. Cheesecake. Shortcake. Orange ganache. Apple pie.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Every single one was handmade by Sacchin and Yumil, you know.」
So Nanaka was the only one who didn't make any cakes...

name: Misasagi
message: 「They barely managed to make it in time for today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Make it in time...? You mean learning how to bake them?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Complete amateurs can't just imitate professionals out of nowhere and expect things to go well.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Though there was one reckless person who tried.」
Sacchin serves Fuyuka-san, Tanimura-san, and Misasagi-senpai.
And Nanaka brings out the sweets for me.
Nanaka was so nervous she looked like she might have a seizure at any second.
An eclair? That wasn't on the menu, though...
Placed in front of the four of us were eclairs packed with chocolate chips inside cream so abundant it looked ready to overflow.
Vividly reviving on my tongue was that rich, sweet, yet somehow refreshing flavor of generous fresh cream.
The slightly bitter chocolate chips paired exquisitely with the fresh cream.

name: Sacchin
message: 「A-Are you okay, Nana-chan?! Did you bite your tongue?」
Nanaka has spent the past month or so practicing how to make this sweet!
Probably this sweet and nothing else.
With the help of Fuyuka-san, Tanimura-san, Misasagi-senpai, and everyone in the Sweets Club.
No, I shouldn't hide behind vague hedging like 'could it be.'

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Umm. S-Synn. If y-you don't want to eat it--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You wouldn't mind being called a coward for the rest of your life, would you now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, please, I'm begging you! Eat it!」
Just like in my distant memories, it was stuffed nearly to bursting, giving it a heavy heft.
Nanaka was looking at me. With pleading eyes.
A sweet... no, overly sweet cream flavor spread through my mouth.
That huge lump I unexpectedly crunched down on must have been an unchopped chunk of chocolate.
Bitter chocolate shards mixed with overly sweet, overly rich whipped cream. A thick, gloopy harmony.
The pastry shell lacked puffiness and crispness, having no bite to it whatsoever.
Yet the chocolate coating on the shell was way too thick and way too hard.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Why...? Following the recipe, with that sense of taste, how did it end up tasting like this...?」
Touka-san tilted her head in puzzlement.
Tanimura-san looked at a loss for what kind of expression to make.
Everyone's eyes were focused on me.
I hesitated for just a moment.
Should I tell her the truth?
Or should I give the socially acceptable answer you'd give to a girl who worked so hard for my sake?

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Wait a second! I-I need to brace myself!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thank goodness--Synn-kun didn't foam at the mouth and collapse--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There's no need to worry 'bout that. After all, we're still alive and kicking」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Even so, I simply cannot accept this. After all that effort, and with Nanaka-san's talent, to end up with this result……」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Yes, indeed. I believe it ought to taste much better than this」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way! I'll keep making it until you say it's delicious, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll stick with you until it turns out delicious」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I won't accept that unless you stick with me even after it gets delicious」

name: Nanaka
message: 「……And also, Synn. Maybe it's a little late to say this now, but」
